tools.name: eventzilla_list_events
tools.description: List the events in the Eventzilla account: id, title, dates and times, venue, status, tickets sold and total, categories and the public URL. Use the id (and dateid) in the other tools. Filter by status and category name. GET /events.

tools.name: eventzilla_get_event
tools.description: One event by id: title, description, dates, time zone, venue, status, tickets sold/total, URL, categories. GET /events/{eventid}.

tools.name: eventzilla_list_event_transactions
tools.description: List the orders (transactions) of one event: order reference, checkout id, date, amount, number of tickets and status. Read-only. GET /events/{eventid}/transactions.

tools.name: eventzilla_list_event_attendees
tools.description: List the attendees (registrations) of one event: name, ticket type, barcode, check-in status, order reference and answers to registration questions. The API returns the whole list in one reply (no paging). GET /events/{eventid}/attendees.

tools.name: eventzilla_list_ticket_types
tools.description: List the ticket types of one event: id, title, price, quantity, sales window and limits, plus its donation ticket options (donation_options). GET /events/{eventid}/tickets.

tools.name: eventzilla_list_categories
tools.description: List the event categories (names to use as the category filter in eventzilla_list_events). GET /categories.

tools.name: eventzilla_get_attendee
tools.description: One attendee by id: name, ticket type, barcode, check-in status, order reference, registration answers. GET /attendees/{attendeeid}.

tools.name: eventzilla_get_transaction
tools.description: One transaction (order) by checkout id or order reference number: amount, ticket count, status, event date. Read-only. GET /transactions/{identifier}.

tools.name: eventzilla_list_users
tools.description: List the account's organizer and sub-organizer users: name, company, contact details, time zone, user type. GET /users.

tools.name: eventzilla_get_user
tools.description: One organizer or sub-organizer by user id. GET /users/{userid}.

tools.name: eventzilla_toggle_event_sales
tools.description: WRITE: publish (status true) or unpublish (status false) ticket sales of one event. Unpublishing stops attendees from buying tickets on the event page; publishing starts public sales again. Existing orders are not touched and no money moves through this tool. Idempotent. POST /events/togglesales.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: eventzilla_list_events, eventzilla_get_event, eventzilla_list_event_transactions, eventzilla_list_event_attendees, eventzilla_list_ticket_types, eventzilla_get_attendee, eventzilla_get_transaction · Private data: eventzilla_list_users · Public sink: eventzilla_toggle_event_sales.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: eventzilla_list_events, eventzilla_get_event, eventzilla_list_event_transactions, eventzilla_list_event_attendees, eventzilla_list_ticket_types, eventzilla_get_attendee, eventzilla_get_transaction · Private data: eventzilla_list_users · Public sink: eventzilla_toggle_event_sales

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
